title: Change Drive Mode
paragraphs: “Now it’s Yuki’s turn—”
“It’s Yuki’s turn, isn’t it! She’s going to fill the hole left by Sakura!”
“This compact was made for the Spear Hero—just for that purpose.”
Rival tossed the compact over to me. Yuki-chan slipped and fell spectacularly. What happened there?
“Is this a comedy skit? Yuki-san completely missed it, didn’t she?”
“Are you practicing comedy?　Why don’t you just go to the Zeltoble Theater or something?”
“That place… well, they have a lot of jokes that are a bit hard to get, don’t they?”
“I won’t deny that they rely too much on inside jokes.”
It seems the Panda is talking with my Big Sister’s Big Sister about Zeltoble’s shop. As expected, he really knows a lot of people.
“I get the feeling Gaelion-chan is aiming for her too.”
“Don’t jump to conclusions. For Yuki, this is definitely something she’ll be happier about than a costume. “Look, Spear Hero, you’re transforming too.”
“Huh? Motoyasu-kun is turning into a Melfilo?”
“Oh, I see—so even a guy can become a Melfilo,” my Father mutters in a tone that makes him sound like he’s from a different era.
“He’s good-looking, so wearing a dress might not look out of place.”
“Coming from you, Itsuki… but you and Ren would look pretty good together, too, for better or worse.”
“Are you the one saying that, Naofumi-san?”
Father furrows his brow at Itsuki’s reply.
“What part of me is ‘pretty girl material’?”
If you ask me, I actually think Father does have some “pretty girl” qualities. He’s quite the homebody, after all.
“Appearance aside, for starters, he’s a great cook, and he’s far more considerate than most women. I think there are plenty of women out there who aren’t as feminine as you are.”
“Itsuki… listen…”
“Ren-san said the same thing before, didn’t he? That if he were a woman, he’d be head over heels for you.”
“Oh my—Naofumi-chan, you’re such a hit with the ladies.”
Big Sister’s Big Sister seems to agree; she’s smiling, too.
“I’m not the least bit happy about that, though.”
“I bet if you took him to a forest with unicorns, they’d swarm all over him.”
“Well, that’s for sure!　When Wild Naofumi went to a certain region, they all gathered around him! Naofumi is no joke!”
“Wait a minute! Don’t prove that! I wouldn’t be happy even if I were swarmed by unicorns attracted to a virgin! Also, why are you a little flustered?”
“Is that the Shield Hero for you?”
My Big Sister picks up the Raph-species and tilts her head as she asks my Father.
“Well… personally, I’m not sure about that aspect of things.”
“But Shield Hero, you’re a kind person, just like Mom, right?”
“Ah…”
“Oh my, does that mean I’m Raphtalia-chan’s dad?”
“Huh? Hmm…?”
My memory tells me this is the moment when the Big Sister I remember would scold her, saying, “What are you talking about, Sadeena-nee-san!”
“Naofumi-chan, it’d be best for Big Sister to go out and work as your husband, wouldn’t it?”
“No, I can’t very well make Sadeena-san do that kind of work right now…”
“Aww, no. Big Sister wants to go fishing, too!”
By the way, the one in charge of fishing for the village is Big Sister’s older sister. Since she’s a fisherwoman, she brings back plenty of fish for us.
“…Getting back to the topic, are you seriously going to dress Motoyasu-kun up?”
“Cross-dressing, you mean? I’ve done that before.”

To honor my grandmother’s last wish, I was forced to transfer to a certain Pig Academy for a while—even though I’m a guy. Back then, they made me dress up as a girl. By the way, a few of the pigs figured me out. The rest of them called me “Big Sister.”
“So that happened…”

“Motoyasu-san’s past is full of mysteries, isn’t it? The other day, during a different loop, Naofumi-san said he was really interested and even put on a wig to recreate your high school hairstyle. It seems like there are still parts of your past you’re hiding.”
That’s quite an insult. What does Itsuki think I am?
“It’s not like that, so don’t worry. For the Spear Hero, all you have to do is attach this compact accessory to your belt while saying ‘Change Drive Mode.’”
“Oh, so that’s not a compact? A belt… I feel like I can see where this is going.”
“Why do I have to do exactly what my Rival says?”
“Motoyasu-san! Everything’s a challenge! Fleon wants to see you transform, too.”
It’s for Yuki-chan’s sake, and Fleon-chan wants to see it, too. Well, I guess I’ve got no choice but to do it.
“Got it! Yuki-chan, Fleon-chan! Watch me transform! Change Drive Mode!”

Just as my Rival told me, I attached it to my belt. Then, the accessory—which I’d thought was just a compact—began to glow and spin, enveloping me, and something resembling full-body armor unfolded. Once the light subsided, I struck a pose worthy of Filolial-sama.
“Shakin’!”
“That’s a Shakin’!”
Fleon-chan struck a pose alongside me!
“Ah, is this a metal hero style? It’s different from the Ranger outfit.”
“Now, try doing Drive Mode from there.”
“What a hassle. Drive Mode it is!”
I’ll switch to Drive Mode just as I was told.
“Oh? It actually looks like a regular motorcycle.”
“The costume really helps tone down that sense of incongruity—or rather, that strange appearance.”
“Yeah, I bet some people would actually think this looks cool.”
“This is… great!”
“It’s wonderful!”
Yuki-chan and Fleon-chan’s eyes are sparkling. The reaction from my Father is excellent, too.
“I think Drive Mode is about half the reason Filo dislikes me. This is a way to mitigate that.”
I can’t just let that slide. Drive Mode isn’t disliked at all! In fact, when I show it to Filo-tan, she runs right over to it. That’s a run of joy, isn’t it?
“Well then, let’s take it for a test drive.”
As if it were the most natural thing in the world, my Rival climbs onto my back.
“Get off! Vroom, vroom!”
I start running and try to shake him off with a wheelie. But that Rival is tenacious—he’s clinging to my back and won’t let go!
“Whoa… It feels like a real wild horse of a bike, so my impression of it hasn’t dropped at all. It also seems like the kind of bike that’s picky about who rides it.”
“It’s a mysterious thing. Just by making it mechanical, the sense of incongruity disappears that much.”
“I guess that just means humans can’t become motorcycles…”
“Motoyasu-sama! Yuki wants to ride with you, too!”
Oh! In this loop, it seems even shy little Yuki-chan is willing to ride with me. That’s pretty great! “Kiiii!” And she slams on the brakes right next to my Father.
“Sakura-chan’s situation aside, Gaelion-chan’s doing a pretty good job, too.”
“That’s right! It was unbearable to watch, so I looked for a solution.”
“Mr. Motoyasu! Now we can form a team of heroes! We can form the Melfilo Squad!”
“But Sakura-chan’s out of the picture, isn’t she? I really don’t think she’ll do it. And is Motoyasu-kun even in the ‘vehicle’ category to begin with? Oh, maybe Yuki-chan will be the replacement?”
Yuki-chan, too, I suppose.
“I’m thinking about whether we should make one for Imiya-onee-chan as an extra too.”
“Huh? Imiya-chan?”
“You know, in Imiya-san’s case, when she transforms, she takes on a Demi-Human form. If we do that, Imiya-san will be happy, right?”
“No, why?”
My father furrows his brow and tilts his head.
“Oh my—that’s obviously Imiya-chan’s worry, Naofumi-chan, you’re such a—”
“Ah… The Bow Hero—that route isn’t for me. Naofumi doesn’t judge people by their appearance; he’s a hero who seeks the heart, so there’s no need to worry about that.”
“Gaelion-chan? What are you talking about? Why are you steering the conversation toward my tastes?”
My Father asks, as if deliberately testing me.
“You really are the Hero of the Demi-Humans and Beastmen. I honestly respect you for that.”
“Itsuki, what exactly are you praising me for? Are Ren and Itsuki going to go into Change Drive Mode and then fuse into three bodies to become some kind of Drive Robot or something?”

Hmm… That’s what they called “super robots” back when I was a kid. I was just about to say that I’d be Drive 1, Ren would be Drive 2, and Itsuki would be Drive 3, right? If we were to recreate those childhood memories, our appearance and preferred terrain would change depending on how we combined. But wouldn’t Ren and Itsuki just be a hindrance at their level?
“Naofumi-san, I’ll just take that as you trying to hide your embarrassment.”
“I was actually being sarcastic… but whatever. You probably wouldn’t do it anyway, but it’d be a problem if you actually did.”
“Next, make one for Rishia.”
“Why? I hear Rishia likes justice too, though…”
This time, Itsuki asks his rival.

“The way Rishia communicates with the Spear Hero is by wearing a costume. Apparently, she puts on a Riska costume and becomes Riska. It seems she was an ally of Fleon and the Bow Hero when they were fighting for justice.”
“S-should I turn this down…? But if Rishia could talk to Motoyasu-san, it might help if something happened…”
“That’s a tough one to answer, Itsuki…”
“Next…”
My father takes out the compact he received from his Assistant and, while keeping a watchful eye on his surroundings, speaks to it.
“Was it Jack? Are you, by any chance, Gaelion—the parent?”
‘…My daughter used some powerful Magic and strength—I have no idea how—to tear me away from the body she had possessed, and by the time I came to, I was in this form…’
“It seems your daughter has actually outdone you.”
“Gaelion-chan too… no, maybe the one who parasitized her before she even hatched is the real problem.”
“Well, if he practices, he can take on a dragon form too. That makes Dad the perfect guardian for big sister.”
“Exactly!” The Rival laughs defiantly.
‘Guh… for my own self to be overthrown like this!’
“Given all the loops, her actual age is probably already older than yours, isn’t it?”
“It’s a bizarre situation—having an older daughter.”
My Father was casting a sympathetic glance at Compact. Doesn’t it matter at all what the Rival’s parents think?
“Brum-brum, here comes our High-Speed Squadron—Time Drive, racing through time—”
“Ah, ah… uuuuuuugh. No way!? Fleon-san’s singing is at it again…”
Itsuki shook her head vigorously, covered her ears, and fled the scene.

“It feels like Fleon-chan’s energy boost has made her singing even more powerful… Since both Ren and Itsuki agreed to create the Raph-species, I’m not sure if I should feel sorry for them, but they’re really having a hard time…”
“Rafu.”
“I wonder if Naofumi-chan will end up the same way with this kid and Raphtalia-chan?”
“I’d hate for that to happen… though I don’t really feel anything in particular about it, either…”

My father stared intently at the Raph-species, gave it a light pat, and then handed it to Big Sister. She looked completely confused as to why he was handing it to her. Anyway, even though she’s not happy about it, Yuki-chan has agreed to run alongside us now.
“Alright, time to switch to Second Mode! Rival, get off!”
She thrashes around to shake off the Rival and enters Second Mode. It’s a bit tricky to handle, isn’t it?
“Ah, she’s not programmed to handle that! Stop it!”
“Whoa! The back-up style!?”
For some reason, my Father is stomping on her hind legs.
“It’s Second Mode! Father, over here!”
“No, I’m actually pretty serious about not wanting to ride that. I feel like he’d do something to me while I’m on there. Please spare me the ‘lovers’ grip’ on the handlebars…”
What do you think I’d do to my Father? It’d be a fun drive with Yuki-chan. I’d like to do that with Sakura-chan, too. If possible, I’d love for her to transform into Filo-tan!
“Oh my…”
“The Shield Hero has it rough, doesn’t he?”

“By the way, since ‘Riding’ is one of the Hero’s skills, both Sadeena and Panda can power up by letting Naofumi ride on their backs! You can ride on Gaelion’s back, too. Oh, and it’s not sexual harassment, you know.”
“It might be a little better if Lars-chan were in Drive Mode.”
“I’d really like to ask why I’m the ‘better’ option.”
“Well, it’s because of those rides you find at amusement parks… Oops.”
Panda was cracking her knuckles.
“Well then, shall the Big Sisters take a ride?”
“Raph-species? Raph-hu!”

When I turned to look at the Big Sister and the Raph-species, the Big Sister took a few steps back like my Father and looked utterly speechless. She’s quite the shy one, isn’t she? On the other hand, the Raph-species sat down on my stomach, striking a pose as if gripping the steering wheel. As always, he’s a monster with great energy. Though his hands don’t quite reach, mind you.
“Is this kid just brave, or does she just enjoy everything?”
“Rafu!”
“I won’t deny that she’s the most unfazed person Gaelion knows.”
What’s that supposed to mean? It sounds like I’m the one surprising everyone here.
“Anyway, Spear Hero, give up on Second Mode! There’s no demand for it, and Yuki’s backing away from it.”
“Is that so?”
“N-No, that’s not it! No matter what happens, Yuki will stay by Lord Motoyasu’s side!”
“Yuki-chan, you don’t have to push yourself.”
“See, Rival! Yuki-chan is delighted.”
“The more you praise her, the weirder she gets. You shouldn’t spoil her.”

Rival is sighing. You’re the one being rude! And so, the toys Rival made were handed out. By the way, Sakura-chan didn’t use the compact. What’s more, she avoided me for a little while. Things went back to normal after a while, though.
I got a little carried away when I suddenly ran into Filo-tan, but when I thought about it calmly, Sakura-chan is still Sakura-chan!
That Rival! Trying to make Sakura-chan hate me… That was a close call. That’s way too cruel! I’ll never forgive him!
